text: will you add debugging to show toggle on the pathing for cars so i can see the actual path over the road
resolution: Added a debug visualization of the car paths over the road. At load the loader builds a thin cyan ribbon (one box instance per route segment, placed just above the road surface, oriented along each segment) tracing every baked route's lane-centered polyline. The P key edge-toggles it on/off in-game (same prev-key-down edge pattern the E interact uses), and RJIT_TRAFFICPATHS=1 turns it on at boot for headless verification. It is its own static box node toggled by setting instance_count, so it costs nothing when off. Verified with rjit game shot RJIT_TRAFFICPATHS=1: the cyan paths render running down the lane centers and turning through intersections, confirming the routing visually. Framework/Zig change → the editor loader pane needs a rjit ship hmsc-int to pick it up; the compiled game shows it now. SHA 351e79056.
